newsitem.title: CHINA: SHUI HING SAYS FIVE PARTIES SEEK STAKE.
newsitem.headline: SHUI HING SAYS FIVE PARTIES SEEK STAKE.

text.p: Department store operator Shui Hing Co Ltd said on Thursday its controlling shareholders had been approached by five parties interested in acquiring a stake in the company.
It said one party was believed to have ties to mainland China while two parties were Hong Kong listed companies.
Shui Hing and the Koo family, which has a 71 percent stake in the company, are being advised by N M Rothschild & Sons (Hong Kong) Ltd, but no decision has yet been made regarding a sale.
Trading in Shui Hing shares was suspended on Wednesday and was due to resume on Thursday. The stock surged HK$4.60, or 42.59 percent, to HK$15.40 on Wednesday ahead of the suspension.
